subject.title: EPIC · Revisión V3 — Nuevo puesto de revisión de producto

question: Should the Revision V3 umbrella stay open until the three remaining child issues are resolved, or should maintainers explicitly split the hardware/analytics leftovers and close the epic scope now?
rationale: The repository evidence shows meaningful work remains, but two remaining items are operational/hardware decisions and one is an analytics model decision, so automation should not decide the epic boundary.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave the epic open as the canonical tracker until the productivity aggregation and kiosk hardware/runbook children are resolved or deliberately descoped.

options.title: Split and close scope
options.body: Move the remaining analytics and hardware items to their own owner-approved tracking path, then close the epic only after documenting that scope cut.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Leave the epic open as the canonical tracker until the productivity aggregation and kiosk hardware/runbook children are resolved or deliberately descoped.

likelyOwner.reason: Alex is assigned on the epic and authored the recent merged Revision V3 branch PRs that document and adjust the implementation.
